roles.title: Lead UI/UX Designer & Front-End Developer
points: Head end-to-end UX/UI design strategy and front-end development across web and mobile platforms for international clients.
Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team of designers and developers, defining scalable design systems and keeping brands consistent.
Run user research, customer journey mapping and wireframing in Figma and Adobe XD to make products easier to use.
Build high-performance, responsive front-ends with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and Bootstrap.
Work alongside product managers and stakeholders in CI/CD and Agile environments.

roles.title: Front-End Developer & UI Designer
points: Designed and built custom responsive website layouts and interactive web components with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Bootstrap.
Created brand collateral, digital displays and marketing materials for corporate clients.

roles.title: Web Designer & Developer
points: Conceptualised and built custom web UI, wireframes and branding from client requirements.
